about_the_game: The Dungeons of Eternity Original Soundtrack tells a story of sound with over 90 minutes of intense orchestral music suitable for all Explorers. Featuring 29 tracks composed by Rob Westwood, Helen Woods, and Òscar Senén, this soundtrack brings the world of Dungeons of Eternity to life with haunting ambient scores and thunderous battle themes. Each piece has been mixed and arranged for a standalone listening experience—available now to elevate your playlist with epic fantasy energy.
